purpose: Test whether a carrier that is nearly radially neutral for the measured CLASH slope can preserve cluster lens roots while retaining differential outward weighting for steeper SPARC profiles.
claim_boundary: This is a deeper numerical replay of four already bridge-fitted settings selected after the measured slope audit.
Universal gravity parameters and transport powers remain fixed; raw lensing fits only common lens geometry, shear, center, and source positions.
The p=-1 q=-0.5 setting is approximately neutral only for the median measured CLASH log slope, not for every cluster radius or system.
A recovered or missing held-out root is an empirical result of the current pseudo-elliptical zero-slip lens closure, not a statement about every possible covariant completion.
The replay is a sensitivity and root-topology test, not an independent holdout.
